item.skyabyss.stone_whale_call.desc: A hollowed whalebone. When blown, a stone whale calf answers from beyond the clouds
item.skyabyss.stone_whale_call.use: Blow: the young one appears at your feet; board it and pick a destination on the chart. Party members (up to 6) can ride too. The adult titan never moves. The calf swims the sky and can carry you anywhere: the starting land, remembered tablets, any titan you have met
item.skyabyss.stone_whale_call.rule: Only the call of a titan you have met works. Its young one comes whenever you blow it (even while the titan sleeps, in a fight or under water)
message.skyabyss.travel.refuse.underwate: You cannot blow the call underwater.
message.skyabyss.travel.refuse.in_combat: In the middle of a fight, the call does not carry.
message.skyabyss.travel.refuse.riding: You cannot blow the call while riding.
message.skyabyss.travel.refuse.cooldown: The whale is still resting (%s s left).
message.skyabyss.travel.chain_hint: Right-click the chain to be lifted to the whale's head
message.skyabyss.travel.too_close: That is too close. Walking is faster.
message.skyabyss.travel.all_aboard: Everyone is aboard. Departing in %s s
message.skyabyss.travel.returned_home: The whale circled back to the sky you climbed from before lowering its chain.
message.skyabyss.travel.woke_landed: When you come to, the whale is gone. It lowered you to the ground.
message.skyabyss.travel.waymark.added: You touch the waymark. "%s" is now a destination (%s / %s).
message.skyabyss.travel.waymark.full: You cannot remember more (up to %s). Forget one on the sky chart.
message.skyabyss.travel.waymark.no_sky: There is no sky above this waymark. Titans cannot see it under a roof.
message.skyabyss.travel.waymark.wrong_di: Titans do not come to this sky.
gui.skyabyss.travel.title: Sky Chart
item.skyabyss.tide_shell_call.desc: A coral-lipped conch. Held to the ear, it murmurs with a distant tide
item.skyabyss.tide_shell_call.use: Blow: the young one appears at your feet; board it and pick a destination on the chart. Party members (up to 6) can ride too. The adult titan never moves. Blow it at the water's edge. The hatchling glides over the sea from shore to shore (it only rolls briefly over land)
item.skyabyss.tide_shell_call.rule: Only the call of a titan you have met works. Its young one comes whenever you blow it (even while the titan sleeps, in a fight or under water)
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_call.desc: A flight feather with lightning running down its vane. Held high, a small wing answers from the storm
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_call.use: Blow: the young one appears at your feet; board it and pick a destination on the chart. Party members (up to 6) can ride too. The adult titan never moves. The fledgling flies low along the ridges. Land destinations only; it will not cross the open sea
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_call.rule: Only the call of a titan you have met works. Its young one comes whenever you blow it (even while the titan sleeps, in a fight or under water)
item.skyabyss.ember_call.desc: A small bell caked in ash. When rung, the warmth underfoot stirs and takes shape
item.skyabyss.ember_call.use: Blow: the young one appears at your feet; board it and pick a destination on the chart. Party members (up to 6) can ride too. The adult titan never moves. The whelp runs over land and wades lava. Only where land runs on; it will not cross deep water
item.skyabyss.ember_call.rule: Only the call of a titan you have met works. Its young one comes whenever you blow it (even while the titan sleeps, in a fight or under water)
message.skyabyss.titan_call.not_met: %s does not know you yet. Go and meet it first
message.skyabyss.titan_call.sleeping: %s is asleep. About %s minutes until it wakes
message.skyabyss.titan_call.met_hint: Your call can be used from the pouch. Blow a met titan's call and its young one appears at your feet and carries you and your party to a destination
message.skyabyss.titan_call.met.stone_wh: The stone whale's song echoed deep in your chest. With this whistle you can call its calf
message.skyabyss.titan_call.met.tide_she: The murmur of the tide stays in your ear. With this conch you can call its hatchling
message.skyabyss.titan_call.met.thunder_: A flight feather drifted down out of the storm. With it you can call the thunder wing's fledgling
message.skyabyss.titan_call.met.ember: The warmth underfoot set into the shape of a small bell. With it you can call the ember's whelp
